theorem forward_radial_heat_equation {a t r : ℝ} (ha : 1 < a) (ht : t < 1) (hr : 0 < r) :
    deriv (fun t => radialProfile a (1 - t) r) t =
      iteratedDeriv 2 (radialProfile a (1 - t)) r + deriv (radialProfile a (1 - t)) r / r -
        radialProfile a (1 - t) r / r ^ 2
